mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 3% triggers a preemptive market anticipation of rate hikes, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0 in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from a zero drift baseline (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL never exceeds 3.0 in the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment momentum as measured by PAYEMS outpaces wage growth (UNRATE), signaling labor market strength that supports equity risk appetite and drives positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > UNRATE growth rate over the current month
failure_condition: Over 60 days, the 20-day forward return correlation with (PAYEMS - UNRATE) is < 0.2 in absolute value, or the signal is reversed in 4 out of 12 monthly windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in GDPC1 (real GDP momentum) below INDPRO (industrial production) suggests demand softening, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and produces negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 100 observations, the 5-day forward return is not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when (GDPC1 - INDPRO) is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO accompanied by a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS creates supply-side headwinds, lowering growth expectations and yielding negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 2% while FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1% in the current month
failure_condition: In 10 consecutive 20-day windows during the trigger, 20-day forward returns are not negative (median > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of FEDFUNDS below 1% (current month and next two months) signals accommodative policy, boosting risk sentiment and producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% for the current month and the following two months
failure_condition: Over 60 days, the 20-day forward return mean is not significantly above zero (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 4% in a month of declining PAYEMS suggests wage growth outpacing job creation, triggering risk-off flows and negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.0 while PAYEMS falls in the current month
failure_condition: In 8 consecutive triggered months, the 20-day forward return is not negative (median > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST (household spending) exceeds a 2% monthly increase while UNRATE remains steady, it signals resilient consumer demand, supporting positive 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth > 2% and UNRATE change ≈ 0 in the current month
failure_condition: Over 50 instances of the trigger, the 5-day forward return is not positive in 40% or more cases (quantile split).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS (retail sales) of more than 5% while INDPRO remains flat indicates supply-side weakness, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 5% while INDPRO change ≤ 0 over the current month
failure_condition: During 10 such events, the 20-day forward return mean is not statistically negative (p > 0.05).
